title: Is it Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon?
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In the city of Orario, gods who have limited their powers sponsor 'familias' of adventurers who explore a vast dungeon to fight monsters. Bell Cranel, a 14-year-old rookie and the only member of the goddess Hestia's familia, is saved by the famous swordswoman Ais Wallenstein and vows to become as strong as she is, gaining a skill that makes him grow faster because of his feelings. Several girls and goddesses fall for him, but he loves only Ais. This manga adaptation of the light novels was discontinued after ten volumes.
life_message: Pure-hearted devotion and hard work can make an ordinary person a hero.
